selected_script.angle: Regular kitchen wipes may work for crumbs and quick touch-ups, but they slide over sticky grease on cabinet handles and range hood edges; Liapu enters as the targeted degreasing spray that cuts the film, wipes clean, and adds antibacterial reassurance.
selected_script.hook: Regular wipes were just sliding over this greasy cabinet film.

script_record.style: realistic handheld UGC phone-shot kitchen demo

talent.description: A relatable American woman in her early 40s, casual home clothes, natural makeup, filming in her own kitchen after cooking.
talent.performance: slightly frustrated at first, then calmly impressed, conversational and credible

must_avoid: do not change bottle color, shape, material, packaging, texture, or proportions
do not add buttons, lights, screens, ports, decorative parts, or extra attachments
do not create text overlays, banners, split screens, platform UI, subtitles, stickers, or watermarks
do not show exaggerated special effects or unsupported cleaning claims

script_record.voiceover_full: Regular wipes were just sliding over this greasy cabinet film. See that sticky streak? After cooking, it ends up on the handles and hood edge too. So now I spray Liapu right on the greasy spots, wait a few seconds, and wipe. It cuts through that oily layer instead of pushing it around. Now it feels clean, not tacky. No harsh residue, just a light lemon scent, and it kills 99.9% of bacteria. Way easier for everyday kitchen cleanup.
